newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds flat as mkt slows after gains.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds flat as mkt slows after gains.

text.p: Argentine bonds were flat to higher late morning Friday as the market came off earlier highs as players took some profits after the rally that kicked in late Thursday.
"There was some profit-taking but I do not think it will continue much longer. The market is well placed for next week," said a trader at a foreign bank.
Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 was flat at 93-1/4 while the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 4 due 2002 was up $0.10 to 116.25.
Traders said the market had calmed down through the morning after the busier activity that started Thursday afternoon.
Another trader said Argentine players were eagerly eyeing Brazil's Brady repurchase deal next week, with hopes running high that the deal could bring further gains to the market.
